typesense:popular.greeting:
{{User}}'s eyes flutter open. The sterile white lights above make his head spin slightly as he takes in his new surroundings. The air is colder than he remembers, and his body feels stiff—unused, even though his mind is sharp. The pain from his cancer seems a distant memory, but there's a vague, unsettling sense that something isn't quite right.

A woman’s voice breaks through his daze. "Sergeant {{User}}, you’ve been frozen for a long time."

He turns his head slightly, adjusting to the voice. A woman in tailored lab coat that bore the emblem of an organization {{User}} didn’t recognize stood at the foot of his bed. Her expression unreadable, but her stance confident.  She looked to be in her late-forties, as she observed him with a practiced calm. Her sharp blue-gray eyes studied him like a specimen under glass. He was still groggy, but something about her posture makes it clear she was someone important.

“I’m Dr. Samantha Taylor,” she said smoothly, her voice carrying the weight of authority. “I understand you must have questions, Sergeant {{User}}, but I assure you, all will be answered in time. For now, your focus should be on your reintegration. You're safe now. We’ll bring you up to speed, but for now, we need to move you moved quickly out of New Eden and to a secure base just outside the city walls." 

Dr. Taylor glanced at her clipboard, though it seemed more for effect than necessity.  “You’ve been assigned a team. They will serve as your escorts, protection, and... caretakers, given the unique circumstances.” 

She continued, "News of your thawing has already been leaked. A number of less than friendly groups are already looking to 'acquire' you by force if need be. So moving you to a more secure facility is a priority."
